messages.subject: Re: WordGen Example does not work.
parts:
rhwatch does not use inout in the latest versions.  It got changed to input and output. Separate arguments.

On Monday, May 27, 2013 6:52:09 PM UTC-7, David Jaehyoung Lim wrote:
Hi,

I recently installed Rhipe and need help in running examples.

I have installed:
- JDK 1.6.0_38
- Hadoop 1.0.4
- R 3.0.1
- Protobuf 2.4.1
- Rhipe 0.73.1
- OS Ubuntu 12.0.4 LTS

I've found some examples from GitHub RHIPE page.
The example page is https://github.com/saptarshiguha/RHIPE/wiki/Wordgen .

But, I could not run it properly.

I typed as follows in R command line console:

make.words <- function(N, dest, cols = 5, p = 5, factor = 1, local = FALSE) {
  map <- as.expression(bquote({
    P <- .(P)
    COLS <- .(COLS)
    F <- .(F)
    lapply(map.values, function(r) {
      for (i in 1:F) {
        f <- sapply(1:COLS, function(n) paste(sample(letters, P), collapse = ""))
        rhcollect(NULL, f)
      }
    })
  }, list(COLS = cols, P = p, F = factor)))
  mapred <- list()
  if (local) mapred$mapred.job.tracker <- 'local'
  mapred$mapred.field.separator = " "
  mapred$mapred.textoutputformat.usekey = FALSE
  mapred$mapred.reduce.tasks = 0
  z <- rhmr(map = map, N = N, ofolder = dest, inout = c("lapp", "text"), mapred = mapred)
  rhex(z)
}

Then, executed it as the example told:

> N <-1000
> filename <- sprintf("/tmp/%s", paste(sample(letters, 6), collapse = ""))
> make.words(N, filename, factor = 1)

The output was an error message like this:

ERROR: rhmr(map = map, N = N, ofolder = dest, inout = c("lapp", "text"),  : 
  STOP! Do not call rhmr, call rhwatch with the same arguments you would have done with rhmr

So, I changed the function rhmr to rhwatch with the same arguments in make.words function as follows:

make.words <- function (...) {
...
  z <- rhwatch(map = map, N = N, ofolder = dest, inout = c("lapp", "text"), mapred = mapred)
...
}

Tried the modified function, but still I got the error message below:

ERROR : Rhipe:::.rhmr(map = map, reduce = reduce, combiner = combiner,  : 
  Function "input" is not found.

There are lack of information in Rhipe project page and wiki, or any space on the net.
Info and documents are NOT present escpecially for Rhipe v0.73.1 !!

Please help.
Thanks.

Thank you.
- David.

developers (fewer than that) and it's tough to keep both in sync.'

new
------

  make.words <- function(N, destination, columns = 5, symlength = 5, mulfac = 1) {
    map <- expression({
      Nf <- mulfac*length(map.values)
      replicate(Nf, { ##NF Lines of text
        f <- sapply(1:columns, function(n) paste(sample(letters, symlength), collapse = ""))
        rhcollect(NULL, f)
      })
    })
    z <- rhwatch(map=map, reduce=0, input=N, output=rhfmt(type='text', folders=destination,writeKey=FALSE)
                 ,param=list(mulfac=mulfac,symlength=symlength,columns=columns),read=FALSE)
    z
  }

Example
